sludge heaviness and doom atmosphere. their raw, abrasive sound placed them firmly within the late‑1990s/early‑2000s underground, while maintaining a distinctly punk ethos. the band’s definitive release is discography (this dark reign recordings, tdr‑13, usa), which compiles studio material from 1999–2002. tracks were originally issued (or intended) across several small‑label documents: south — berserker records (ber‑005, compilation. crushers killers destroyers! — shifty records (sh08, compilation. doomed — this dark reign recordings (tdr‑001, compilation. mugwart performed throughout virginia and the surrounding region, sharing stages with grief, damad, fistula, sofa king killer, and clutch. in 2011, uk extreme‑metal band dragged into sunlight selected mugwart’s track “fallen” for a curated mixtape in terrorizer magazine (issue #285), highlighting the group’s ongoing resonance nearly a decade after disbanding. legacy: though short‑lived, mugwart is regarded as a sludge heaviness and doom atmosphere. their raw, abrasive sound placed them firmly within the late‑1990s/early‑2000s underground, while maintaining a distinctly punk ethos. the band’s definitive release is discography (this dark reign recordings, tdr‑13, usa), which compiles studio material from 1999–2002. tracks were originally issued (or intended) across several small‑label documents: “fallen” for a curated mixtape in terrorizer magazine (issue #285), highlighting the group’s ongoing resonance nearly a decade after disbanding. legacy: though short‑lived, mugwart is regarded as a
